utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Good morning to everybody in and around the courtroom. Mr. Registrar, please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning to everyone in and around the courtroom much. This is case number IT-04-81-T, the Prosecutor versus Momcilo Perisic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Could we have the appearances for the day, please, starting with the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. HARMON
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning, Counsel. Good morning, everyone in the courtroom. Mark Harmon, Rafael La Cruz, and Carmela Javier for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Harmon. For the Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning to everyone participating in the proceedings. Mr. Perisic is today represented by Boris Zorko, Gregor Guy-Smith, and Novak Lukic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Lukic. Mr. Lukic.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, according to schedule, we were supposed to hear Mr. Slobodan Kosovac, who was our expert witness. We wanted to inform the Chamber, as we had the OTP a moment ago, that this Defence will not hear this expert testimony, and we wish to withdraw our motion that his expert report be tendered into evidence. As for why I'm only addressing the Chamber regarding this issue, I can tell you that for the past four and a half days, we went through an intensive proofing. This included the weekend as well as daytime and in the evening, and this was our final conclusion, which we reached late yesterday afternoon. That is why we had to wait for Monday morning to inform you of this.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Lukic. May the Chamber please move into private session.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We're back in open session, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much. Mr. Lukic, do we now postpone to the 29th? I don't have my diary with me.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: In the morning, Mr. Registrar, on the 29th?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you. We stand adjourned to the 29th of November in the morning, 9.00, in Courtroom II. Court adjourned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Monday, the 29th day of November, 2010, at 9.00 a.m. 25

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 9.14 a.m.,
